title: Godot project
responsibility: Plans the Godot scene, headless check and export files used by the Harness game scaffold.

inputs.name: godotProjectFiles.input
inputs.description: Reads the name and optional dimension from a selected Godot game request. The caller validates the name and dimension. The template defaults to 2d.

outputs.name: godotProjectFiles
outputs.description: Returns relative paths and contents for the project, matching scene and headless test, macOS and Web export presets and runner scripts.
